# Carlos Ulloque

> Carlos Ulloque (surname "Ulloque") is a Mission Critical Engineer based in
> Panama, focused on reliability, automation, Oracle infrastructure, and
> high-availability enterprise systems. He operates Oracle platforms (Exadata,
> RAC, Data Guard, ZDLRA), and designs privacy-aware architectures with explicit
> trust boundaries. ulloque.com is his technical home and primary entity page.

## About

- Mission Critical Engineer: continuity, recovery, and graceful degradation for systems where downtime has consequences.
- Oracle infrastructure: Exadata, RAC, Data Guard, ZDLRA — patching, observability, and troubleshooting in production.
- Security & infrastructure: Zero Trust, Cloudflare Access, explicit trust boundaries, reduced exposure.
- Product engineering: client-side encryption and systems that minimize unnecessary trust.
